title: Items picked together are not checked against each other
what: In lanes_state, a pick is also compared with the picks already chosen in the same call (by `where` files, hubs as today); the later pick waits and its line names the other ('waits: same file as <slug>'), which is also the start counter the design asks for.
why: 28 Oct, design-batch revision 2 section 3: lanes_state (plugins/front/lib/relay_lanes.py 243-254) compares each pick only with files running branches changed, never with the other picks of the same call. py-green, setup-dirty and doctor-exit started within 7 s with lib/relay_setup.py in each `where`; the night then cost a hand-built train-23 with merge conflicts. Holds under every grouping option.
failing_case: Two open fixes whose `where` names lib/relay_setup.py, no lane running, 2 free lanes: both are picked.
pass_cases: The same input: one pick, one wait naming the other.
Two picks with disjoint `where`: both picked.
A pick that overlaps a running branch still waits as today.

fact: 28 Oct, front decision on review F4 (owner can reverse), by principle 10 (the default does the right thing; a refusal names the next step): a wait is binding. `relay queue start <slug>` refuses an item that waits because its files are being changed, names the item it waits for, and takes an explicit override flag for when the front means it. Review F1 (reproduced): picks started one at a time by `relay queue start` are not compared, because a fresh branch has no changed files; a taken item must count as occupying the files in its `where` until its branch changes files.
